# Tests the unprivileged CI go test may skip: "<package> <test>", where a trailing * matches any rest of the line, so
# "<package> *" is every test in it. ci.yml fails on any other skip, so a test that starts skipping (a tool missing from
# the runner) shows up. Each line says why.

# needs the agentbox-powercut image in a podman machine; hack/powercut.sh runs it on the Mac
agentbox/hack TestPowercutCheck
# chattr needs CAP_LINUX_IMMUTABLE; the "go test internal/audit as root" step reruns this package and fails on any skip.
# Tests only: the nightly fuzz jobs run unprivileged, so a fuzz target that skips here would never fuzz (#270)
agentbox/internal/audit Test*
# ns_last_pid, setpriv and a PID namespace need root; the "go test the tasks gate's PID takeover as root" step runs it
agentbox/hack TestTasksGatePIDTakeover
